strongest_objection: The map's hinge item rests on a mechanism that does not survive a counterexample. Silent minority report says a witness at the time ruins the repair because a spoken dissent is a challenge and gets priced; but a recorded dissent, in minutes, at a central bank, on a court, is spoken, dated, held by the room, and read back against the outcome, and it is the strongest form of holding a view against a room, not a ruined one. So the stated reason is wrong and the faculty repaired is misnamed: what the silent dated note actually repairs is the survival of the person's own view across their own fold, and the silence is the presenting condition (someone who can afford to speak the dissent does not need the file) rather than the mechanism. The repair below keeps the strange member and the hinge adjacency to Sealed slip, which still teaches. Beyond that, three items (Weather rule, Move ban, Fresh ledger) omit the witness clause the of-sentence makes part of the type, and Sealed slip credits the seal with a fix it does not make: with the seal the grader is still the defendant, who now fails by selecting which envelopes to open rather than by revising them. I tried to collapse Sealed slip into Borrowed bookkeeper, Honest kitchen into Fresh ledger and Late apprenticeship, and Stranger's baseline into Borrowed reliance, and each pair separated on a case. The edges show the fork, dependency, passage, and incompatibility they claim, and a bare walk would have hidden the Second copy → Split the roll dependency and the Which organ fork.

items.item: Silent minority report: when the room overrules the judgment, the overruled view is written and dated before folding, not spoken, and read back against the outcome months later, as a junior analyst keeps a private file of every forecast she was talked out of; repairs the capacity to hold a view against a room, carried by the dated private note, and it is ruined by a witness at the time, since a spoken dissent is a challenge and gets priced, and needs one later, since a file only its author reads is a slip without a seal; the note must carry the date on which someone else opens it, or it becomes a second life.
items.why: The recorded-dissent counterexample breaks the stated witness mechanism ('a spoken dissent is a challenge and gets priced') and shows the faculty is misnamed: a person who can hold a view against a room out loud does not need this repair. What the silent note guards is the person's own pre-fold view against their own post-fold rewriting; the silence is the condition under which the repair is needed, and the file is the cheap trial of the expensive public act. The later-opening seal and the second-life failure are right and kept.
items.repair: Silent minority report: when the room overrules the judgment, the overruled view is written and dated before folding, not spoken, and read back against the outcome months later, as a junior analyst keeps a private file of every forecast she was talked out of; repairs the survival of the person's own view across their own fold, since a view one folded on is the easiest to remember afterward as never held, and a dissent spoken and minuted is a different instrument that repairs standing before the room rather than before oneself; carried by the dated private note, silent because whoever can afford to speak the dissent does not need the file, so the file is the cheap trial of the expensive act; needs a witness later, since a file only its author reads is a slip without a seal, and the note must carry the date on which someone else opens it, or it becomes a second life.

items.item: Sealed slip: a small prediction is written, dated, and put where the writer cannot amend it before the outcome arrives, as a dismissed forecaster keeps a drawer of dated envelopes on the week's weather; repairs calibration, carried by the seal rather than by any person, and without the seal it fails because the grader is the defendant, who remembers the hits; not the count of calls, which is Long denominator's work, but one call's honesty.
items.why: The alone-failure clause says that without the seal the grader is the defendant who remembers the hits; but with the seal the grader is still the defendant, who now chooses which envelopes to open and count. The seal fixes revision of content, not selection of the set; selection is Borrowed bookkeeper's work, and the item should say so, since that is what separates the two closest custody items.
items.repair: Sealed slip: a small prediction is written, dated, and put where the writer cannot amend it before the outcome arrives, as a dismissed forecaster keeps a drawer of dated envelopes on the week's weather; repairs calibration, carried by the seal rather than by any person, and the seal guards only the content, since the grader is still the defendant, who can no longer revise an envelope but still chooses which ones to open and count, so alone it fails by selection where it no longer can by revision; not the count of calls, which is Long denominator's work, and not custody of the whole drawer, which is Borrowed bookkeeper's, but one call's honesty.

items.item: Weather rule: the conditions under which the judgment fails are catalogued, tired, flattered, hurried, when the number is round, and the judgment is trusted outside its known weather, as a pilot with one bad night rules out flying into that weather rather than out of flying; repairs the timing of decisions rather than the decisions, carried by the catalogue, and alone it works but shrinks, since each new miss adds a weather until nothing is flyable; not Which organ, which quarantines a faculty, and not Move ban, which quarantines an act.
items.why: The of-sentence names four parts, faculty, carrier, alone, and when a witness may enter; this item has no witness clause, and the seriation note places it in the band where the witness enters as a grader without the item saying so. The natural witness is the reader who names a weather the pilot cannot see from inside it and who refuses the catalogue its shrinkage.
items.repair: Weather rule: the conditions under which the judgment fails are catalogued, tired, flattered, hurried, when the number is round, and the judgment is trusted outside its known weather, as a pilot with one bad night rules out flying into that weather rather than out of flying; repairs the timing of decisions rather than the decisions, carried by the catalogue, and alone it works but shrinks, since each new miss adds a weather until nothing is flyable, so a witness may enter afterward as the reader who names a weather the pilot cannot see from inside it, flattery above all, and who refuses the catalogue an entry for every miss, never as the one who grounds the flight; not Which organ, which quarantines a faculty, and not Move ban, which quarantines an act.

items.item: Move ban: the one move that broke it is named and forbidden outright, the double-down, the loan to the brother, the email sent after midnight, with all other judgment left free, as a founder who lost the company on a second bridge rules out ever bridging with personal money again; repairs the standing to decide everything else by quarantining the failure in one move, carried by a rule that needs no understanding to enforce, and alone it drifts, since the banned move is redescribed until it is no longer the banned move; distinct from Which organ, which explains, where the ban only fences.
items.why: Same type omission: no witness clause, though the alone-failure (redescription of the banned move) is exactly the failure a witness can hold, on the pattern One-turn key already sets (the witness holds the calendar, never the key).
items.repair: Move ban: the one move that broke it is named and forbidden outright, the double-down, the loan to the brother, the email sent after midnight, with all other judgment left free, as a founder who lost the company on a second bridge rules out ever bridging with personal money again; repairs the standing to decide everything else by quarantining the failure in one move, carried by a rule that needs no understanding to enforce, and alone it drifts, since the banned move is redescribed until it is no longer the banned move, so a witness may hold the description of the move and rule on whether tonight's loan is the loan, never the decisions the ban leaves free; distinct from Which organ, which explains, where the ban only fences.

items.item: Fresh ledger: judgment is moved to a domain where the person has no record yet and a record is built there before it is walked back, as a trader who lost the fund learns to sail and returns two seasons later able to say what he now does with a bad read of the wind; repairs the record by giving it a clean page, carried by the new domain's own scorekeeping, and alone it becomes flight, since the domain was chosen for being unscored and nothing forces the return; not Stranger's baseline, which keeps the domain and changes the audience.
items.why: No witness clause, and the omission misplaces it on the declared axis: the new domain scores the hand itself, so the only witness it tolerates is the one who holds the return date, and it belongs at the kitchen end of the walk rather than among the afterward graders. Adding the clause both completes the type and fixes the placement.
items.repair: Fresh ledger: judgment is moved to a domain where the person has no record yet and a record is built there before it is walked back, as a trader who lost the fund learns to sail and returns two seasons later able to say what he now does with a bad read of the wind; repairs the record by giving it a clean page, carried by the new domain's own scorekeeping, and alone it becomes flight, since the domain was chosen for being unscored and nothing forces the return, so the only witness it tolerates is the one who holds the return date, since the domain scores the hand itself and a watcher at the tiller is the kitchen's ruin; not Stranger's baseline, which keeps the domain and changes the audience.

items.item: Borrowed bookkeeper: the tally of calls and outcomes is kept by someone with no stake in the person's fitness and no access to their revisions, as a founder after a blown company gives a friend the log and the right to read it back unedited; repairs the credibility of the record to its own subject, carried by custody outside the subject's revising hand, and it cannot be done alone by definition, while a bookkeeper with a stake in the verdict, a spouse, a rival, a creditor, returns the score to the teller's hands.
items.why: Tested as the closest neighbor of Sealed slip; separated by the selective-opening case (see neighbor_test). It is the custody of the set, where the seal is the custody of one envelope.

items.item: Honest kitchen: the judgment is exercised where the world scores it within seconds and the score cannot be argued with, the sauce breaks, the boat rounds up, the note is flat, as a surgeon who missed the diagnosis takes up the cello; repairs the felt link between deciding and anything happening, carried by the medium's refusal to be persuaded, and it is a repair a witness ruins, since a watcher turns the world's verdict into a performance for the watcher and the sauce is then broken in front of someone; a witness may taste the result later but not stand at the stove.
items.why: Tested against Fresh ledger (separates: the kitchen keeps no record and repairs the felt link, the ledger keeps one and walks it back) and against Late apprenticeship, where the same act, a craft taken up at forty, is claimed to be ruined by a watcher in one item and repaired by one in the other. That is a real incompatibility the map does not own; it is flagged under modality and named as the seed rather than repaired, so as not to domesticate the stranger claim.

neighbor_test.left: Sealed slip: a small prediction is written, dated, and put where the writer cannot amend it before the outcome arrives, as a dismissed forecaster keeps a drawer of dated envelopes on the week's weather; repairs calibration, carried by the seal rather than by any person, and without the seal it fails because the grader is the defendant, who remembers the hits; not the count of calls, which is Long denominator's work, but one call's honesty.
neighbor_test.right: Borrowed bookkeeper: the tally of calls and outcomes is kept by someone with no stake in the person's fitness and no access to their revisions, as a founder after a blown company gives a friend the log and the right to read it back unedited; repairs the credibility of the record to its own subject, carried by custody outside the subject's revising hand, and it cannot be done alone by definition, while a bookkeeper with a stake in the verdict, a spouse, a rival, a creditor, returns the score to the teller's hands.
neighbor_test.separating_case: A dismissed forecaster who seals every weekly slip and, at year's end, opens only the envelopes she remembers being right. Every seal is intact and no content was revised, yet her calibration is unrepaired: the seal guards the envelope and she still curates the drawer. Hand the drawer to a friend with no stake who opens all of them and reads the tally back unedited, and the same slips become Borrowed bookkeeper. The two separate on what is held in custody, the content of one call versus the membership of the set, and the case shows Sealed slip's alone-failure clause misattributed selection to the absence of the seal.

boundary_case: The second-opinion habit: every call is checked with a no-stake friend before acting. Tempting because it involves exactly the witness the map prizes, someone outside the subject's revising hand, and looks like Borrowed bookkeeper run in advance. Out: the witness enters before the call, so the friend's judgment is what gets exercised and the person's is never tested; it institutionalizes the deference that was the injury, the apology's mechanism made routine. Borrowed reliance is in on the reversed direction, since there the other person uses the subject's judgment rather than supplying one, and One-turn key already states the rule that a witness handed the decision has replaced the judgment.

seriation.note: The axis has real endpoints, nobody at the stove and a hearer who is the whole repair, and the hinge adjacency Silent minority report → Sealed slip still teaches after the report's repair: both are a dated note the writer cannot amend, and the report adds a seal against the room that must later turn around. One placement is arbitrary on the declared axis: Fresh ledger sits among the afterward graders, but its only witness is the domain itself, so it belongs beside Honest kitchen; the witness clause added in its repair makes this explicit. The band Weather rule through Split the roll from the bet is defended by the seriation note as the grader's band, but only Split the roll's item text said so before the repairs.

edges.why: A real conditional whose antecedent fails when the sorting names nerve. But the fork form_inference claims is three-tined and only two tines are edges; the One-turn key branch lives inside this label. The map has six edges and room for a seventh (Which organ → One-turn key, 'If the sorting finds the calls were right and unacted on, no slip helps and the route is the key'), which would make the fork visible as structure rather than as a sentence.

The passage between levels holds and the antecedent can fail (a watcher at the stove). Note that the eater who does not know the verdict is the borrower's ignorance, so the edge's condition and the target's carrier are the same fact, which is what makes it a passage and not a sequence.

modality_problems: Silent minority report: 'a spoken dissent is a challenge and gets priced' is a speculative social mechanism stated as the reason the repair fails, and the practice of recorded dissent contradicts it; repaired above with the modality kept as a tendency ('easiest to remember afterward as never held').

Honest kitchen: 'a repair a witness ruins' is stated without qualification, while Late apprenticeship puts a master at the bench as the repair for the same act. The difference, a watcher who merely sees versus one who scores what the medium cannot, is not owned by either item or by an edge; left unrepaired so the strange claim survives, and named as the seed.

Sealed slip: 'without the seal it fails because the grader is the defendant' presents the seal as removing the defendant from the grader's chair; it does not, and the item is repaired to say what the seal leaves unfixed.

Stranger's baseline: 'the verdict of unfitness turns out to be local' states the favorable outcome as the mechanism's result; the mode note hedges it but the item does not. A stranger who also finds the person unfit is the mechanism working, and the item should be read as learning whether the verdict travels. Not repaired, since the mode field carries the hedge.
duplication: No whole-map overlap. Item-level adjacency to witness-architectures is acknowledged in boundary_claim (Borrowed bookkeeper and Second copy of the past against Arm's-length custody; Silent minority report against Half kept back in the crossfield opening) and what is added is real: custody against the subject's own hand, and reliance repaired rather than standing established. An unacknowledged minor adjacency: Fresh ledger's walk-back is a form of return in forms-of-return's sense (the returner comes back inscribed with the interval, its Writ returned), but the item's mechanism is the clean page, not the return, so it does not duplicate.
best_unresolved_seed: What the witness may do, not only when it may enter. Honest kitchen and Late apprenticeship disagree about the same act, a craft taken up at forty, and the disagreement is not about timing: the cello teacher and the joiner's master both stand at the bench, and the map's axis has no room for the difference between a watcher who sees, one who holds a seal, one who scores what the medium cannot score, and one who uses the result. A second axis of four witness instruments (see, hold, score, use) would split every 'witness' in this map into a named instrument and would say when a watcher is the kitchen's ruin and when it is the apprenticeship's whole repair; it would also settle whether the small-stake ratchet, acting on the judgment at a stake raised by rule each month, is a repair (a Long denominator with a rising bet) or a permanent way of never trusting it.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the witness mechanism of Silent minority report, the alone-failure of Sealed slip, and adding the witness clause the type requires to Weather rule, Move ban, and Fresh ledger; no item cut, no neighbor pair collapsed.
